title: The Guaranteed Minimum Value Sold With a Northbeam Renew Trade-In Trade-Up
content:
On the Northbeam Renew Trade-In trade-up programmes the customer was sold a guaranteed minimum value: the credit is never below the Renew programme's guarantee percentage of what the device was bought for, provided the trade falls inside the guarantee term counted in whole months from the purchase day. The guarantee stands only while the device meets the programme's condition requirement; where it does not and the programme forfeits the guarantee on damage, the ordinary condition ladder governs and the guarantee pays nothing. Where the ordinary appraisal supports more than the guaranteed floor the higher amount is credited, since the guarantee is a floor and not a ceiling. The guaranteed floor is read from the amount written onto the agreement when it was opened, not recalculated from today's prices. A device traded outside the guarantee term is appraised as an ordinary trade-in on that programme, and the floor is not prorated for the months that had run.

**The floor against the appraisal.** The guarantee sets a floor under the credit, so of the two figures the higher is credited:

| How the ordinary appraisal stands against the guaranteed floor | What is credited |
| --- | --- |
| the appraisal supports less than the floor | the floor |
| the appraisal supports more than the floor | the amount the appraisal supports |

**The term.** The term is counted in whole months from the purchase day. A trade inside the term has the floor behind it; a trade outside the term is appraised as an ordinary trade-in on that programme, with no proration of the floor for the months that had run.

**The condition requirement.** The floor stands only while the device meets the programme's condition requirement. Where the device falls short of it and the programme forfeits the guarantee on damage, the ordinary condition ladder governs and the guarantee pays nothing.

**Where the figure comes from.** The guaranteed floor is the amount written onto the agreement when it was opened. It is not worked out afresh from the prices standing today.
